correctness.rationale: On strict KKT regions the residual derivative is exactly one-block centering Q_S with zero off-block coordinates. Binary-cut coarea reduces its complete-pair Gini norm to a finite exact scalar maximization, yielding (m-1)(2n-m)/[m(n-1)]. The finitely many affine regions bound all two-input changes. Every pooled size is strictly realizable with all positive penalties, and a local one-leaf perturbation attains the formula. The integer difference identity establishes the maximizer and asymptotics; the packaged independent exact-KKT checker confirms small cases but does not substitute for the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: Residual differences, rather than fitted differences, are used in outlier and suppression diagnostics. The sharp star-specific Gini sensitivity has an exact first-expansion threshold at n=4, a nontrivial optimal pooled-size law m approximately sqrt(2n), a dimension-growth asymptotic to two, and complete penalty-magnitude independence. These are natural, structurally explained finite-size and asymptotic invariants for this standard nonlinear operator, without any claim of a general graph theorem.
